TAX-1-INVARIANT-IMMUTABLE-PITIC-001.text: TaxProfile, TaxRate, and any referenced law/reporting configuration used for an OrderTaxRecord MUST be point-in-time immutable. Any change to rate, inclusion rules, credit-note reporting requirements, or jurisdiction mapping MUST create a new immutable config instance and MUST NOT mutate previously referenced configs. OrderTaxRecord MUST persist digests of the exact configs used (PITIC digests).

TAX-1-INVARIANT-JURISDICTION-EVIDENCE-HA.text: OrderTaxRecord MUST persist jurisdiction_evidence_sha256, a sha256 hex digest of the normalized jurisdiction evidence payload used at time-of-tax-point, so that tax correctness can be proven even if underlying PII is later rotated/purged (PII retention mismatch).

TAX-1-INVARIANT-TAXCTX-V2-TENANCY-SALT-0.text: tax_context_digest_sha256 computed under TAXCTX-V2 MUST include org_id as a salt/input component, preventing cross-tenant digest replay/collision. A digest MUST NOT be accepted unless its declared digest_version matches the canonical field set.

calculation_arithmetic: All money is integer minor units. Floating point arithmetic MUST NOT be used.
Inclusive mode: gross_total_minor is canonical; taxable_amount_minor and tax_amount_minor are derived. tax_amount_minor MUST equal gross_total_minor - net_total_minor.

Exclusive mode: net_total_minor is canonical; tax_amount_minor is computed as round_half_even(net_total_minor * rate_basis_points / 10000). gross_total_minor MUST equal net_total_minor + tax_amount_minor.

canon_item_ref_type_for_tax.statement: TaxableLineInput.item_ref_type MUST be canonical; unknown values MUST be rejected (fail-closed).

MUST: TAX-1 MUST define a credit_note_reporting_profile for each tax_profile_id to determine the legally required fields for refund documents (credit notes) in the given jurisdiction.

Refund document generation MUST use the credit_note_reporting_profile captured in OrderTaxRecord for the original order, unless an override is explicitly authorized via QUORUM-1 and recorded as part of refund processing.

Credit note generation MUST bind each credit note to both the origin tax point (tax_point_at_utc from the original OrderTaxRecord) and the issuance time (issuance_at_utc) used for ledger posting in an open period.
credit_note_reporting_profile_digest_sha256 MUST cover (at minimum) sequence_strategy and template_version_id so that both numbering rules and document format remain legally reproducible.
When issuance_at_utc is forced into a later open ledger period, reports MUST still link the credit note to the origin liability at tax_point_at_utc.
For any CreditNote, issuance_at_utc MUST be greater than or equal to origin_tax_point_at_utc.
details: This contract does not attempt to model every global tax authority. It instead requires the system to snapshot the reporting profile used at point-of-sale so that point-of-refund remains legally reproducible.

credit_note_finalization: A CreditNote is NOT legally valid until it is finalized with a non-null ledger_posting_id referencing a successful LED-1 LedgerPosting.

Transition rule: legal_status MUST remain 'pending_ledger' until ledger_posting_id is set. When ledger_posting_id is set, legal_status MUST become 'finalized' and both fields MUST become immutable thereafter.
Bidirectional audit bridge: CreditNote.ledger_posting_id MUST match LED-1 LedgerPosting.refs.tax_credit_note_id for the same CreditNote.id (one-to-one).

MUST: TAX-1 MUST define a finite set of credit note sequence strategies and their deterministic credit_note_id generation rules.
Sequence generation MUST be tenant-scoped unless explicitly configured otherwise in the reporting profile snapshot.
Sequence generators MUST be monotonic within their configured scope and MUST NOT reuse identifiers.
details: The intent is to prevent Credit Note ID drift when reporting profiles evolve. ID generation must be reproducible from the snapshotted reporting profile config.

jurisdiction_resolution: Tax jurisdiction MUST be resolved deterministically per sale using (a) event_location by default, (b) org_location or manual override only when explicitly configured.
If jurisdiction cannot be resolved, the event/ticket MUST NOT be sellable (fail closed) (TAX_JURISDICTION_REQUIRED).
ledger_reconciliation: For every settled order, the sum of OrderTaxRecord.tax_total_minor MUST reconcile exactly to the tax liability postings in LED-1 for that order (same org_id + currency).
Tax liability postings MUST be reversible via TaxAdjustmentRecord on refunds/chargebacks.

rules.rule: When issuing a CreditNote, origin_tax_point_at_utc determines the fiscal period. If origin_tax_point_at_utc falls inside a CLOSED fiscal period (as defined by LED-1 fiscal period closure), the CreditNote MUST be rejected unless the linked LedgerPostingIntent is explicitly flagged as prior_period_adjustment=true. Ledger effective_date for the CreditNote posting MUST use origin_tax_point_at_utc (NOT issuance_at_utc). Violations fail-closed.

details: If a PRICE-1 PricingSnapshot includes any PriceLine with item_ref_type='platform_fee', the resolved tax_scope MUST be 'all_customer_charges' for that order tax context.
Tax computation MUST include platform_fee lines in taxable_amount_total_minor and tax_total_minor under the same tax_context_digest_sha256 recorded for the order.

If the PricingSnapshot.platform_fee_tax_context_digest_sha256 is present, it MUST equal OrderTaxRecord.tax_context_digest_sha256 when platform_fee_payer_mode='buyer'; otherwise fail closed with ERR_VALIDATION/TAX_CONTEXT_DIGEST_MISMATCH.
Silent exclusion of platform_fee lines (e.g., treating them as non-taxable while charging them) is forbidden.
platform_fee_taxability.statement: Platform fee customer charges MUST be taxed deterministically when present.

pricing_integration.assertion: PRICE-1 integration MUST be deterministic and auditable.
details: PRICE-1 PriceLine.unit_price_minor MUST represent the net-of-tax unit amount in minor units.
PRICE-1 PriceLine.tax_total_minor MUST represent the total tax for the line (minor units) computed under the resolved TAXCTX-V2 context.
PRICE-1 PriceLine.line_total_minor MUST represent the gross customer-payable line total and MUST equal: quantity*unit_price_minor + fee_total_minor - discount_total_minor + tax_total_minor.

In inclusion_mode='inclusive', the customer-facing advertised unit price is gross; systems MUST derive net unit_price_minor and tax_total_minor using TAX-1 calculation_arithmetic rules (reverse-calc).

In inclusion_mode='exclusive', the customer-facing advertised unit price is net; systems MUST compute tax_total_minor and present gross totals no later than the first price quote (no 'surprise' tax at final submit).

pricing_transparency: Default behavior MUST NOT introduce new customer-payable tax at checkout (inclusive mode).
If exclusive mode is enabled, customer-facing UI MUST disclose that prices exclude tax BEFORE add_to_cart and MUST show the tax line item at checkout.
Tax amounts MUST NOT be client-supplied; they MUST be server-computed from canonical inputs only.
privacy: Tax computation MUST use the minimum PII necessary. Default storage is country/region only; full addresses are OPTIONAL and MUST be access-controlled.
rate_selection: Tax rate selection MUST be effective-dated (effective_from/to) and deterministic at calculation time.
There MUST NOT be overlapping active rates for the same (jurisdiction_code, tax_class). Violations MUST hard-fail administrative writes (TAX_RATE_OVERLAP).
rounding: Rounding mode MUST be half-even at minor unit precision (bankers rounding).
Rounding drift allocation across multiple lines MUST be deterministic (e.g., allocate remainder to the last line sorted by stable line_id).

Tax-inclusive back-calculation MUST use: tax_portion_minor = round_minor(total_minor * rate_basis_points / (10000 + rate_basis_points)) using the TaxContextV2.rounding_mode; net_minor = total_minor - tax_portion_minor.

For partial refunds where a tax amount must be apportioned across multiple refunded lines, implementations MUST use a deterministic apportionment algorithm: compute each line's exact_fractional_tax = (line_total_minor * rate_bp)/(10000+rate_bp) (inclusive) or (line_total_minor*rate_bp/10000) (exclusive), take floor to minor, then allocate the remaining remainder_minor by descending fractional remainder with stable tie-breakers (line_id, then item_ref) to ensure sums match the target tax_total_minor.

single_context_per_snapshot.assertion: TAX-1 supports a single TAXCTX-V2 context per PricingSnapshot.
details: A PricingSnapshot MUST be bound to exactly one TaxContextV2 (via tax_context_digest_sha256).
All PriceLines within that snapshot MUST be computed under the same TaxContextV2 (same jurisdiction_code, tax_class, inclusion_mode, tax_scope, rounding_mode).
Mixed-jurisdiction or mixed-tax-class line items within a single order are out-of-scope for TAX-1 and MUST be prevented (split order or future TAX-2).

snapshot_and_audit: OrderTaxRecord MUST be created atomically with order finalization and MUST reference the PRICE snapshot signature used to collect funds.
OrderTaxRecord MUST be immutable. Corrections MUST be represented as TaxAdjustmentRecord rows.

MUST: Implementations MUST compute tax_context_digest_sha256 using the TAXCTX-V2 canonical string described below, then SHA-256 hashing it to lowercase hex.
OrderTaxRecord MUST persist tax_profile_id, tax_rate_id, tax_scope, rounding_mode, provider_mode/provider_name, jurisdiction fields, and tax_context_digest_sha256 as immutable snapshot fields.

tax_profile_id MUST refer to an immutable, versioned TaxProfile record whose semantics SHALL NOT change after issuance (including inclusion_mode defaults, rate selection rules, rounding_mode, and reporting requirements for refunds/credit notes). If tax law changes, a NEW tax_profile_id MUST be issued; existing orders/refunds MUST continue to bind to the original tax_profile_id unless an explicit break-glass override is recorded.

OrderTaxRecord MUST snapshot the TaxProfile's law_version and credit_note_reporting_profile as immutable fields (in addition to the existing snapshot fields) to prevent refund 'time-travel' compliance drift.

Any refund processed using a different tax_profile_id than the original order MUST be treated as an override and MUST satisfy QUORUM-1 attestation requirements (override evidence binding) and MUST record both the original and override tax_context_digest_sha256 values.
OrderTaxRecord.tax_context_digest_sha256 MUST equal PRICE-1 PriceSnapshot.tax_context_digest_sha256 for the same priced context (order / line-item scope as defined by PRICE-1).
If the digest does not match, implementations MUST fail closed with ERR_VALIDATION/TAX_CONTEXT_DIGEST_MISMATCH and MUST NOT persist the record.

canonical_string_TAXCTX_V2.digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical bytes, encoded as lowercase hexadecimal.
encoding_rules: Encode each field as key=value in the declared field order.
Encode missing or null values as an empty value after equals.
org_id is mandatory even though its digest component uses the same encoding.

tax_policy_locking.assertion: Resolved tax context MUST be stable once sales exist (no silent drift).
details: For a given occurrence_id, once any Order reaches a completed/paid state for that occurrence, the resolved TaxContextSnapshot fields (jurisdiction_code, tax_class, inclusion_mode, tax_scope, rounding_mode, provider_mode/provider_name, tax_rate_id) MUST NOT change for future quotes/orders for that same occurrence_id.

If the organizer requires a tax policy change (rate, inclusion, jurisdiction basis), the platform MUST create a new occurrence_id and/or a new PricingProgramRevision for future sales and MUST preserve prior context for already-issued orders for audit.
Attempted mutation of an active occurrence_id tax posture MUST fail closed with ERR_CONFLICT/TAX_MODE_INVALID (or stricter).

rules.text: Tax/VAT MUST be INCLUDED in customer-facing prices by default (TaxProfile.default_inclusion_mode='inclusive').
Org MAY configure exclusive checkout tax addition, but only via explicit TaxProfile setting (allow_event_override=true).
Tax basis MUST default to event_location for physical admission tickets; org_location/manual are explicit overrides only.
Clients MUST NOT send tax amounts. Server MUST compute taxes from canonical inputs only.
Order finalization MUST persist OrderTaxRecord with rate/jurisdiction breakdown sufficient for statutory reporting.
Tax totals MUST reconcile to LED-1 postings; mismatches MUST block settlement/payout (TAX_TOTAL_MISMATCH).
If using external provider_mode, tax quotes MUST be cached by input hash and provider quote_id to avoid drift + rate limits.
If vat_registration_number is present, invoices/receipts MUST display it for the taxable entity.
TaxLine supports multi-rate scenarios; current baseline MAY emit exactly 1 TaxLine per OrderTaxRecord when only one rate applies.
PRICE-1 PriceLine.unit_price_minor MUST be net-of-tax; gross payable totals MUST be represented via tax_total_minor + line_total_minor (see TAX-1 pricing_integration).

Resolved tax context MUST NOT change for an occurrence_id after the first completed Order for that occurrence_id; changes MUST require a new occurrence_id and/or new PricingProgramRevision and MUST fail closed otherwise.
A PricingSnapshot MUST be bound to exactly one TAXCTX-V2 (tax_context_digest_sha256); mixed jurisdictions/tax classes inside one snapshot are out-of-scope for TAX-1 and MUST fail closed.

For each order, the platform MUST resolve a single tax_point_strategy and tax_point_at_utc and record both in OrderTaxRecord. Rate selection and reporting SHALL reference this tax point. Strategy MUST be explicit; defaults are allowed only via TaxProfile.

When provider_mode is external/hybrid, the platform MUST record external_quote_id and external_quote_generated_at_utc. If external_quote_expires_at_utc is present (provider-supplied or TTL-derived), the platform MUST re-quote before payment authorization/capture when the quote is stale.

Tax scope (ticket_only vs all_customer_charges) MUST be enforced using TaxableLineInput.item_ref_type and the canonical registry in TAX-1. Canonical values MUST include: ticket_type, platform_fee, addon. Ticket lines MUST use item_ref_type=ticket_type. Fee lines MUST use item_ref_type=platform_fee. Unknown item_ref_type MUST fail closed with ERR_VALIDATION/TAX_ITEM_REF_TYPE_UNKNOWN. Discount-only lines MUST NOT be passed as TaxableLineInput; discounts MUST be represented via discount_total_minor.

When tax_basis or jurisdiction_source requires customer location, the platform MUST store only a derived customer_location_key (non-PII) in tax evidence. Raw address evidence MUST NOT be stored in TAX domain artifacts; it MUST be stored in a dedicated PII vault boundary outside TAX and referenced only via an opaque customer_location_evidence_ref.

TAXCTX-V2 canonical digest input MUST be a UTF-8 string with fields in this exact order: org_id, jurisdiction_code, inclusion_mode, rounding_mode, tax_class, rate_basis_points, tax_scope, tax_basis, provider_mode, provider_name, tax_point_strategy. Delimiter '|' and key=value format. Missing fields MUST be encoded as empty string, not omitted.

A shared immutable effective-dated platform TaxRate MAY be global only under TEN-1 explicit allowlist and isolation constraints. Tenant-specific tax truth, including TaxProfile, remains tenant-scoped.

Quote resolution returns a deterministic immutable TAXCTX-V2 value. The resolver accepts the exact ProductRevision.tax_profile_id and returns that same tax_profile_id, inclusion_mode, tax_point_strategy, evaluated_at_utc, digest_version, and digest_sha256. applicable_tax_rate_revision_refs and PII evidence outputs remain subject to their separately defined source mappings. TAX-1 does not persist a TaxContext resource. PII-1 owns direct jurisdiction evidence.

TAX_ITEM_REF_TYPE_UNKNOWN.message: Tax calculation received a non-canonical item_ref_type.

TAX_JURISDICTION_REQUIRED.notes: Event/ticket tax jurisdiction could not be resolved.

TAX_PROFILE_REQUIRED.notes: Org has no active tax profile but is attempting to sell.

TAX_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.notes: External tax provider not reachable or returned non-retryable error.

TAX_RATE_OVERLAP.notes: Overlapping effective tax rates detected for same jurisdiction/tax_class.

summary: Defines the platform tax/VAT posture for ticketing: default tax-inclusive pricing to avoid checkout surprises, optional tax-exclusive checkout add-on per org/event, jurisdiction resolution (event vs org location), deterministic calculation + rounding, immutable tax audit records per order, and reconciliation expectations against PRICE-1 snapshots and LED-1 postings under V42 money invariants.

notes: Default posture is VAT/tax INCLUDED in advertised ticket price (conversion protection).
Org/event MAY switch to tax added separately at checkout when required by local norms/regulation.
All tenant-scoped TAX resources MUST enforce org_id isolation via Postgres RLS.
Platform-scoped tax rate tables MUST be writable only through platform.tax_rate.create by an authorized platform principal.

title: TAX-1 Tax & VAT Inclusion, Calculation, and Audit Contract
ui_requirements: Checkout MUST show a distinct tax line item (e.g., 'VAT') regardless of inclusion mode. Inclusive mode MUST present it as included in the total.
Ticket creation backend MUST allow setting inclusion_mode (default inclusive) and tax_basis override only when org policy allows it.
If exclusive mode is used, the UI MUST show 'excluding tax' messaging before add_to_cart and MUST never introduce taxes not included in the quote shown to the user.
